partialText:
<p>Most tool documentation shows one box and one arrow. TDK CLI is bigger than that. A single <code>tdk up</code> passes through TypeScript commands, Starlark discovery and generators, a generated Tiltfile, Docker containers, a Traefik proxy, and a set of checks that run before anything starts.</p>

<p>This article draws the whole system in one Mermaid diagram, then walks through it. The diagram follows the repository's own maintainer guide (<code>docs/TOPOLOGY.md</code>) and the folders I read in the source. Some labels are summaries, so check the names against the repo before you rely on a single one.</p>

<h2>
  
  
  How to read it
</h2>

<p>Start at the top left. A developer, or an agent over MCP, enters the CLI. The CLI has three jobs: scaffolding files through templates and providers, reading the project's commands, and starting the stack.</p>

<p>The middle of the diagram is the two-stage generation the maintainer guide describes. The CLI writes starter files in TypeScript. At Tilt time, Starlark discovery reads each <code>service.json</code>, and the engine's generators write the runtime files under <code>.autogenerated/</code>. Those files are what Docker and Tilt run.</p>

<p>The right side shows the checks. <code>doctor</code> answers whether the machine can run the stack. The drift check compares generated files with their snapshots before startup. The dry run prints the plan. The readiness output tells you, or an agent, when a service is ready.</p>

<p>The bottom shows the runtime: Tilt drives Docker, Docker runs the Traefik proxy, Postgres, the service containers, and NATS when it is enabled. Production sits outside the loop. The diagram ends with Helm, Argo CD, and Kustomize, because TDK does not generate cluster manifests by default.</p>

<h2>
  
  
  Things the diagram leaves out
</h2>

<p>It does not show every module or every generator. The <code>.tdk-contract</code> snapshots, the optional observability stacks, and the golden image layer are simplified or omitted. Use the repo's topology guide when you need the full list.</p>

<h2>
  
  
  Summary
</h2>

<p>TDK CLI is a loop: TypeScript commands write project files, Starlark generators turn <code>service.json</code> into runtime files, checks confirm the result, and Docker and Tilt run it. Keep the inputs in your hands, treat the generated files as output, and let the checks tell you when something has drifted.</p>
